description: For a well-founded extensional relation on a set-sized carrier, its collapse is injective and relates two points exactly when their images are related by membership.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse_injective.{u, v} {α : Type v} [Small.{u, v} α] {R : α → α → Prop}
  (h : WellFounded R) (he : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.Extensional R) :
  Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h) ∧
    ∀ (a b : α),
      R a b ↔ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h a ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h b
